panels.text: Jayshreeben ને call આવ્યો: 'UIDAI office. Aadhaar update ન કરો તો block!'
Caller: 'Aadhaar expired! Send photo of Aadhaar card + fingerprint + OTP — otherwise block in 2 hours!'
redFlags: UIDAI ક્યારેય phone પર Aadhaar photo ન માંગે
'2 hours' — ઉતાવળ ઉભી કરે — time for thinking ન આપે

panels.question: Jayshreeben શું કરે?
panels.correct: Phone મૂકો, UIDAI official number 1947 call કરો

panels.wrongOutcome: ❌ Aadhaar share → bank account fraud, loan ઠગ ના નામ 😢
panels.rightOutcome: ✅ Jayshreeben 1947 call — UIDAI confirmed no such requirement 🎉

panels.rule: Aadhaar card ની photo ક્યારેય WhatsApp / phone પર ન મોકલો.
panels.subtext: Aadhaar expire ન થાય. UIDAI ક્યારેય phone/WhatsApp પર document ન માંગે.

panels.text: Jayshreeben received a call: 'UIDAI office. Update Aadhaar or it will be blocked!'
Caller: 'Aadhaar expired! Send photo of Aadhaar card + fingerprint + OTP — otherwise blocked in 2 hours!'
redFlags: UIDAI never asks for Aadhaar photo over the phone
'2 hours' — artificial urgency — no time to think

panels.question: What should Jayshreeben do?
panels.correct: Hang up and call UIDAI official number: 1947

panels.wrongOutcome: ❌ Shared Aadhaar → bank fraud, loans taken in her name 😢
panels.rightOutcome: ✅ Jayshreeben called 1947 — UIDAI confirmed no such requirement 🎉

panels.rule: Never send your Aadhaar photo on WhatsApp or phone.
panels.subtext: Aadhaar does not expire. UIDAI never asks for documents over phone or WhatsApp.

quiz.en: What is the UIDAI official helpline number?

quiz.gu: Aadhaar photo WhatsApp પર ક્યારે send કરો?
quiz.en: When should you send your Aadhaar photo on WhatsApp?

explanation.gu: Aadhaar photo WhatsApp / phone પર ક્યારેય ન મોકલો.
explanation.en: Never send your Aadhaar photo via WhatsApp or phone.
